arguments.sql_query:
-- RxNorm standard concepts for each statin (drug_era_level)
SELECT concept_id, concept_name
FROM omop.concept_recommended cr
JOIN omop.concept c ON cr.target_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
  AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
  AND c.domain_id = 'Drug'
  AND LOWER(c.concept_name) IN ('atorvastatin', 'simvastatin', 'rosuvastatin', 'pravastatin', 'lovastatin', 'pitavastatin', 'fluvastatin')
ORDER BY c.concept_name;
